notes: The mod ships RU-Transmog.json next to the DLL; Jotunn does not find it outside Translations/<Language>/, so the mod's own fallback loads it as Russian into its CustomLocalization (confirmed in LogOutput.log). All 28 keys have Russian, so no words are filled.
Only gap: the toggle hotkey message is a string.Format literal shown through Character.Message; its on/off arguments are separate literals of the same method.
